LanguageData.MST.prerequisitesComment: Research projects that must be finished first. Drawn as lines on the research tree.
LanguageData.MST.hiddenPrerequisitesComment: Also a hard prerequisite, but no line is drawn on the research tree.
LanguageData.MST.requiredResearchBuildingComment: Research bench needed to work on this project. Empty means any bench works.
LanguageData.MST.requiredResearchFacilitiesComment: Facilities that must be linked to the bench and active.
LanguageData.MST.requiredAnalyzedComment: Things that must be analyzed first (Biotech).
LanguageData.MST.requiresMechanitorComment: A mechanitor must exist in the colony to start this project (Biotech).
LanguageData.MST.requireGravEngineInspectedComment: A grav engine must be inspected before this project can start (Odyssey).
LanguageData.MST.recalculatePowerComment: Recalculate the power network when this project completes.
LanguageData.MST.customUnlockTextsComment: Extra entries appended to the "unlocked" list in the research info card (Odyssey).
LanguageData.MST.heldByFactionCategoryTagsComment: Faction categories that hold techprints of this project (Royalty). Must be non-empty whenever techprintCount is above 0.
LanguageData.MST.teachConceptComment: Concept taught to the player when this project completes.
LanguageData.MST.discoveredLetterTitleComment: Title of the letter shown when this project is discovered.
LanguageData.MST.discoveredLetterTextComment: Body of the letter shown when this project is discovered.
